PUBLIC DOMAIN

All audio files in this repository are performances by the United States
Navy Band, a unit of the United States government. As works of the U.S.
federal government, they are in the public domain and not subject to
copyright protection in the United States.

You may use these files for any purpose, including:
- YouTube videos and other video content (no Content ID claims)
- Commercial projects
- Apps, games, and software
- Presentations and educational materials
- Broadcasts and podcasts

No attribution required, though credit to the U.S. Navy Band is appreciated.

Source: Wikimedia Commons
